description: This source file defines a React component named 'Renewal' that provides a user interface for extending a tourist's validity period. It includes form inputs for 'Tourist ID' and 'Extra Days', performs validation, and interacts with an API endpoint to perform the renewal operation. It also includes UI elements for loading states and success/error notifications.

classes.name: Spinner
classes.description: A simple React component that renders a spinning SVG icon to indicate loading.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the form inputs for 'Tourist ID' and 'Extra Days'. Sets errors if validation fails.

methods.name: onRenew
methods.description: Handles the click event to perform tourist renewal by calling the API. Shows success or error toasts based on the outcome.
